content: Purpose of attribute DiagnosticDataIdentifier . repre- sentsVin There is a use case for identifying a specific DiagnosticDataIdenti- fier that carries the so-called vehicle identification number (VIN). It is therefore important to be able to formally indicate this characteristic. For this purpose the attribute DiagnosticDataIdentifier . representsVin is available.
